title: Issue using rclone copy to existing bucket
body:
> What is your rclone version (eg output from `rclone -V`)
```
[user@some-server ~]$ rclone -V
rclone v1.37
```

> Which OS you are using and how many bits (eg Windows 7, 64 bit)
```
[user@some-server ~]$ cat /etc/*-release
CentOS Linux release 7.3.1611 (Core)
NAME="CentOS Linux"
VERSION="7 (Core)"

CentOS Linux release 7.3.1611 (Core)
```
```
[user@some-server ~]$ uname -a
Linux some-server 3.10.0-327.3.1.el7.x86_64 #1 SMP Wed Dec 9 14:09:15 UTC 2015 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux
```

I’m not sure what I’m doing wrong here. I’m specifying an existing bucket in the configured gcloud project. I’m simply trying to copy a single file into that bucket. It appears to be trying to create a bucket? I’m confused.

[user@some-server foo]$ ls
hello-world.txt
[user@some-server foo]$ pwd
/tmp/foo
[user@some-server foo]$ ls
hello-world.txt
[user@some-server foo]$ rclone -vv copy ./hello-world.txt some-gcloud-project:some-gcloud-bucket
